hero.headline: Turn a lesson source into an interactive Arabic class
hero.subheadline: Upload an image or text, and the system generates a complete interactive lesson. All you do is review and approve — no files, no code.
hero.imagePlaceholder: Screenshot of the lesson player interface

before.title: Same idea, none of the manual work
before.oldStep1: Manually prepare the lesson image or text
before.oldStep2: Copy it into an external AI tool
before.oldStep3: Manually edit the lesson file's code
before.oldStep4: Manually open the file to check it works
before.newStep: The teacher uploads the source, and the system handles generation, formatting, and running it

how.title: From source to class, in six steps
how.step1Body: A lesson image, text, or a PDF or DOCX file
how.step3Body: AI builds the full lesson behind the scenes
how.step4Body: Freely edit any word, question, or activity, with autosave
how.step5Body: The lesson becomes an approved, ready-to-run version
how.step6Body: A full-screen view, suited for the classroom whiteboard

levels.title: One level governs every word in the lesson
levels.subtitle: The teacher picks it before generation, and the system applies it to every word, sentence, and question
levels.level1Body: Limited reading of letters and words, with almost no conversation
levels.level2Body: Simple introductions and basic conversation, with early writing
levels.level3Body: Varied vocabulary, more complex sentence structures, and more fluent conversation

features.title: Everything a teacher needs, and nothing else
features.f1Body: Edit any part of the lesson — you won't lose a thing if you close the browser
features.f2Body: The lesson displays using the same interactive activity system already in use
features.f3Body: Share any approved lesson with a single link — no account needed for the recipient
features.f4Body: Every generation has a fixed cost, and your balance is always visible
features.f5Body: Edit an approved lesson without touching the version used in class
features.f6Body: Sort your lessons into folders by level or topic, and find them in seconds before class

generation.required: This field is required in the generated lesson content.

generation.dialogueCount: The number of dialogue lines must be between 6 and 12.

generation.conjugationItemsCount: There must be at least 6 conjugation items.
generation.mcqCount: There must be exactly 3 multiple-choice questions.

generation.fillBlanksOneBlank: A fill-in-the-blank sentence must contain exactly one blank.

generation.paragraphBlankMismatch: The number of blanks in the paragraph must match the number of answers.
generation.contextAnalysisSeparator: The context analysis question must contain the " · " separator between the Arabic and Chinese parts.
generation.challengeBlankMismatch: The number of blanks in the challenge must match the number of answers.
generation.dialogueFillOneBlank: A dialogue fill-in line must contain exactly one blank.
generation.dialogueFillCount: The number of dialogue fill-in lines must be at least 4.

generation.smartFeedbackCount: Smart feedback must contain at least 3 items.
generation.dragWordsCatMismatch: Each drag-word category must match one of the drop-zone categories.
generation.invalidExplainLabel: An explanation point label must start with a circled number (① etc.).
